# Chapter 2: The Merchants of Borisol

The Borisol market was crowded from early morning.

Erian had come out to buy herbs on the old man's errand.

The merchants glanced at the boy from the tower.

A woman caught hold of his sleeve.

"Is it true that the master of the tower has returned?"

Erian did not answer and bowed his head.

Then soldiers carrying the guild's banner appeared.

He gathered the herbs in a hurry and slipped out of the market.
